description: Simple and affordable stay for up to 6 guests. Two mezzanines, three double beds and one single bed. Living room with international TV, open kitchen and modern bathroom. Compact space, basic comfort. Great base to explore Paris on a budget.The space🇬🇧 Right in the center, for a great price!Welcome to a perfectly located apartment for discovering Paris without breaking the bank. Just 5 minutes from the Louvre, this compact flat can host up to 6 guests.⚠️ Please note before booking:It’s a budget-friendly, simple and practical spot—not a luxury stay. Ideal for explorers looking to be in the heart of the action.✅ What you’ll find: • First room: double bed + single bed on mezzanine (3 sleeping spots) • Second room: cosy living room with sofa bed, open kitchen, mezzanine with double bed • Recently renovated bathroom with modern shower • TV with international channels • Kitchen with microwave, Nespresso machine, kettle…ℹ️ Keep in mind: • The space is tight, especially for full groups or long stays. • Some wear on the furniture, though it’s carefully cleaned. • We cannot stand up in the mezzanineA great value to explore Paris at a low cost.🗺️ Neighborhood and Transportation🇬🇧 You’re right in the heart of Paris!Walk to the Louvre, Le Marais, Beaubourg or Les Halles in just minutes. The area is lively, filled with cafés, restaurants and Parisian landmarks.Nearby Metro Stations: • Louvre-Rivoli (Line 1) - 5 min • Bourse (Line 3) - 5 min • Châtelet - Les Halles (Lines 1, 4, 7, 11, 14 & RER A/B/D) - 5 minDirect access from CDG and Orly airports via RER B.
